text: Based on the evidence from NASA FIRMS, there were no thermal anomaly detections within the asset ASSET-F02 during the period from 2026-09-25 to 2026-10-24. However, the evidence is insufficient for the last two days (2026-10-24 to 2026-10-25) due to temporal gaps in the data. While no fires were detected during the covered days, it's important to note that small, short, cool, or cloud-obscured fires may not have been detected. Therefore, we cannot definitively conclude that no fires occurred during the entire evaluated period.
